label: copy-phase fed-back h/e (mid-to-late recall), esp. before h/e/u/b/v output
predicate: (phase == 2) & isin(in_tok, [tok("h"), tok("e")]) & isin(out_tok, [tok("h"), tok("e"), tok("u"), tok("b"), tok("v")]) & (recall_idx >= 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the fed-back input token is h (63% of mass) or e (37%). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases and never on any other input token except for a few on b. Within that context it is concentrated at recall_idx 3-5 (none before 3), and when the token being output is also from {h,e,u,b,v}, i.e. on adjacent pairs like e->h, h->e, h->h, h->u. Activations are larger in longer sequences (L=9 holds 64% of mass) and peak at t=12-13; the strongest examples are e->h or h->e pairs at recall_idx 4. The dev predicate gets recall 0.87 and mass recall 0.91, but precision is only about 0.09: most steps that match the context stay silent, so the description covers the activation mass but not when the feature fires.
